newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Agrium Inc raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Agrium Inc raised to buy.

text.p: --NatWest Securities Corp said Monday it raised its rating on Agrium Inc to buy from accumulate because of the company's plans to merge with Viridian Inc.
--The firm set raised its price target on its shares listed on the New York Stock Exchange to $18 from $16.

--Agrium said Sunday it agreed to merge with Viridian in a stock transaction. The combination of the two leading Canadian nitrogen producers would create the fourth-largest fertilizer company in North America. Under the proposal, Viridian stockholders will receive 0.975 shares of Agrium for each Viridian share.
--In New York, Agrium was trading at 13-3/4, off 1/4, at 1530 EDT/1930 GMT.
